role: Test runner (make test-coverage; ci.yml tests job when scope != gates) that runs xcodebuild test with coverage, retries once on simulator-infrastructure markers, then runs check_coverage.sh.
state: env:SCHEME, PROJECT, RESULT_BUNDLE (build/TestResults.xcresult), MIN_COVERAGE, TEST_SCOPE (unit|full), DESTINATION, MAX_TEST_WORKERS (3), MAX_SIM_CLONES (1), PARALLEL_TESTING (NO), TEST_DERIVED_DATA
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; sources preflight (no cd). TEST_SCOPE: unit -> -only-testing:EmuquTests and exports SKIP_OVERALL_COVERAGE=1/SKIP_LOGIC_COVERAGE=1 (coverage reported, not gated); full -> all targets; other -> exit 64. DESTINATION from select_simulator_destination.sh if unset (the else branch assigns DESTINATION to itself, a no-op). rm -rf result bundle. TYPE_CHECK_FLAGS add -warn-long-expression-type-checking=4000 / -warn-long-function-bodies=6000 via OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS. Loop (max 2 attempts): run_tests; status 0 -> break; else counts "' failed" lines and infrastructure markers ('Application failed preflight checks', 'Failed to get matching snapshots', 'process main thread busy', 'Unknown application display identifier'); if attempt<2 and any marker -> `xcrun simctl shutdown all`, sleep 10, rm bundle, retry the WHOLE run regardless of how many tests failed; else exit with the status. After success runs check_coverage.sh <bundle> [MIN_COVERAGE]. Comments at 79-93 say MAX_SIM_CLONES 'stops cloning', while 95-102 say that flag has nothing to do with clones and PARALLEL_TESTING=NO is the real lever; both flags are still passed.

units.does: Runs `xcodebuild test` with project/scheme/destination/result bundle, parallel-testing flag, worker and destination caps, optional -only-testing and -derivedDataPath, extra type-check OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS and code coverage, tee'ing to $TEST_LOG; returns xcodebuild's exit status.
